findings.title: Reflected XSS with alert filter bypass via String.fromCharCode
findings.description: The /page endpoint reflects the 'name' parameter without proper sanitization. The application filters the word 'alert' but can be bypassed using String.fromCharCode() encoding to execute arbitrary JavaScript.

reproduction.expected: XSS alert with 'XSS' string triggers, revealing the flag
